title: FR-NORTHSTAR-001 Qualified Task Survival Frontier

north_star.name: QUALIFIED_TASK_SURVIVAL_FRONTIER
north_star.primary_question: What is the minimum resident RAM required to complete useful work while all task and non-RAM resource contracts still pass?
north_star.anti_cheat: A RAM reduction is not a win if quality, semantic correctness, p99 latency, reliability, CPU, IO, or network-like budgets are violated.

research_policy: A new atom is only promoted when it improves the qualified survival frontier or closes a measured failure-domain gap.
